evaluate.expression: (async () => { const sessionId = localStorage.getItem('bas.replay.sessionId') || document.body.getAttribute('data-replay-session-id') || ''; let paneSeen = false; let ok = false; const deadline = Date.now() + 6000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const pane = sessionId ? document.querySelector(`[data-testid="terminal-pane"][data-session-id="${sessionId}"]`) : document.querySelector('[data-testid="terminal-pane"][data-session-id]'); const text = pane ? (pane.textContent || '') : ''; if (pane) paneSeen = true; if (pane && text.includes('BAS_REPLAY_OK')) { ok = true; break; } await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); } document.body.setAttribute('data-replay-session-id', sessionId); document.body.setAttribute('data-replay-pane-present', paneSeen ? 'true' : 'false'); document.body.setAttribute('data-replay-ok', ok ? 'true' : 'false'); })()
